name: ETAS
desc: Bosch subsidiary providing automotive ECU calibration, measurement, diagnostics and embedded vehicle software (INCA, AUTOSAR RTA-CAR) to carmakers and suppliers.

name: Zeppelin
desc: German foundation-owned group selling and servicing Caterpillar construction machinery, renting equipment, and supplying power systems and plant engineering in 29 countries.

name: Russell Investments
desc: Seattle investment firm founded in 1936 offering multi-asset funds, outsourced CIO and investment consulting to clients in 32 countries.

name: Witron
desc: Upper Palatinate builder of automated order-picking, palletising and material-flow systems, mainly for grocery retailers, with branches in nine countries.

name: Unipart
desc: Oxford-based, majority employee-owned supply chain, logistics, manufacturing and rail products group serving automotive, retail, technology and rail customers.

name: Rowe Motor Oil
desc: Family-owned German maker of motor oils, lubricants and coolants, selling about 1,400 products in more than 80 countries.

name: Everllence
desc: Augsburg maker of large two- and four-stroke marine and power engines, turbochargers, compressors, heat pumps and electrolysers, renamed from MAN Energy Solutions in 2025.

name: Böllhoff
desc: Fourth-generation family-owned German maker of fasteners, threaded inserts and assembly systems for automotive and industry, active in 26 countries.

name: Uno-X Mobility
desc: Self-service Nordic mobility chain offering fuel, EV fast charging and car wash at more than 300 Norwegian sites plus a Danish network.

name: Allspring Global Investments
desc: Charlotte-based global asset manager, formerly Wells Fargo Asset Management, independent since November 2021 under private equity ownership.

name: Alain Afflelou
desc: French optical and hearing-care franchisor with about 1,400 stores, mainly in France and Spain, majority-owned by Lion Capital.

name: SD Worx
desc: Antwerp-based payroll, HR software and workforce services provider serving 105,000 customers across 26 European countries.

name: Gerflor
desc: Lyon-based maker of vinyl, linoleum and sports floors including Taraflex and Connor Sports, owned by Cobepa and ICG with management.

name: Andreessen Horowitz
desc: American venture capital firm founded by Marc Andreessen and Ben Horowitz, investing in technology companies across stages.

name: Radiall
desc: Family-controlled French maker of RF, microwave, fibre-optic and multipin interconnect components for aerospace, defence, space, telecom and industry.

name: The Travel Corporation
desc: Travel group founded in 1920 owning guided-tour and cruise brands including Trafalgar, Contiki, Insight Vacations, Uniworld and AAT Kings.

name: Multi-Color Corporation
desc: Global maker of prime labels for consumer brands: pressure-sensitive, cut-and-stack, roll-fed, in-mould, shrink-sleeve and heat-transfer labels.

name: Brown Advisory
desc: Baltimore investment management firm, originally the investment arm of Alex. Brown & Sons, majority owned by its employees.

name: Xtrac
desc: British engineering company designing and making gearboxes and driveline systems for F1, IndyCar, NASCAR, sportscars, rally and high-performance road cars.

name: Handtmann
desc: Biberach family group making food-processing filling and portioning machines, light-metal castings, plant engineering and plastics technology.

name: Optic 2000
desc: French opticians' cooperative behind about 1,150 Optic 2000 stores plus Lissac and Audio 2000, long-time sponsor of the Tour Auto Optic 2000 historic rally.

name: Lush
desc: Poole-based maker and retailer of handmade cosmetics, bath products and skincare, selling through about 886 shops in roughly 50 countries.

name: Sega
desc: Sega Sammy's video game publisher behind Sonic the Hedgehog, Yakuza, Persona and Football Manager, with Rovio in Finland.

name: Groupe Pilote
desc: French motorhome maker founded in 1962, behind the Pilote, Bavaria, Le Voyageur, Moveo, Joa and Hanroad brands; one of France's three main makers.

name: Ceratizit

name: FORUM8

name: ROWE Mineralölwerk

name: NI
desc: US maker of automated test and measurement hardware and software (LabVIEW, PXI, CompactDAQ), now Emerson's Test & Measurement business group.

name: Avolon
desc: Dublin-based aircraft lessor with an owned, managed and committed fleet of about 897 aircraft leased to airlines worldwide.

name: Jama Software

name: TVH Parts
desc: Belgian family-controlled global distributor of spare parts and accessories for forklifts, aerial work platforms, construction and agricultural machinery.

name: DoubleLine Capital

name: Lone Star Funds
desc: Global private equity firm founded by John Grayken investing in corporate equity, real estate, credit and financial assets.

name: New Mountain Capital

name: PAG
desc: Hong Kong investment firm managing private equity, private debt, real estate and hedge fund strategies across Asia-Pacific.

name: VanEck
desc: New York global investment manager mainly issuing ETFs, a pioneer of gold and foreign-growth investing, with offices in Europe and Asia-Pacific.

name: Doppelmayr
desc: Vorarlberg family group building aerial ropeways, urban cable cars, amusement rides, material ropeways and warehouse systems, with 15,800 installations in 96 countries.

name: NORD Drivesystems
desc: Family-owned Hamburg-area maker of geared motors, gearboxes, high-efficiency electric motors and frequency inverters, with production in Germany, Europe, the US, China and India.

name: Comexport
desc: São Paulo foreign-trade company calling itself Brazil's largest, handling indirect imports, logistics, tax optimisation and trade finance for clients.

name: Silk Way West Airlines
desc: Baku-based all-cargo airline of the Silk Way Group flying Boeing 747 and 777 freighters to about 45 destinations across Europe, Asia and the Americas.
